native_method: 24 release-native traces: 300/1200 ticks × 32/64/128 boxes × unforced/mixed × two repeats. Tick QA uses the fixture independent OBB SAT. State hashes are same-build DefaultHasher observations, not portable hashes. Native and WASM differ; both must independently repeat/pass.
memory_scope: WASM reports bookkeeping+geometry+island+transaction vector payload; bookkeeping already includes position scratch. Excludes authoritative bodies/contact history, response/constraint storage, tree/allocator overhead and RSS. Native log reports bookkeeping+geometry subset only.
timing_scope: One real WASM f64 world step, including scheduled projectile insertion/lifecycle. Excludes all observations, independent geometric QA, hashing, rendering and JS loop.
raw_evidence_files: 193-{current-budget,wasm-long-final}.json; 193-native-long-final.log; full raw timestep timings are retained locally rather than copied into this summary.
